errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: The server ran into a problem. Try again in a moment.

login.title: Sign in
login.schoolHint: This account exists in several schools.
login.panelTitle: Every student's attendance, known to their family the same day.
login.featureAttendance: Attendance taken every period, even offline.
login.featureLateness: Lateness recorded at the gate by the assistant DMs.
login.featureFamilies: Parents told the same day, by notification or SMS.

password.title: Choose your password
password.intro: Your current password is temporary. Choose a new one to continue.
password.tooShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
password.tooLong: The password must have at most 72 characters.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

home.mobileOnly: This space is for administrators, Discipline Masters, counsellors and the researcher. Use the SchoolLink mobile app.

crud.deleteText: Deleting is permanent. An item still in use (for example a class with students) cannot be deleted.

structure.label: Label
structure.name: Name
structure.pickYear: Select an academic year to see its terms.
structure.pickTerm: Select a term to see its holidays.
structure.calendarIntro: The school year, its terms and the holidays in each term.
structure.yearsHint: Pick a year to see its terms.
structure.termsHint: Pick a term to see its holidays.
structure.periodsIntro: The lesson time slots, from the first to the last of the day.
structure.classesIntro: Blocks, each followed by a Discipline Master, and the classes of each year.
structure.blocksHint: Every class belongs to a block.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.lessonHint: Only the teachers assigned to this class are listed.
timetable.noTeaching: No teacher is assigned to this class yet. Assignments are made in staff management.
timetable.intro: Each class's lessons, day by day and period by period.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Name
staff.contactHint: A phone or an email is required; it is used to sign in.
staff.languageHint: Language of the messages sent to this person.
staff.passwordOnce: It will not be shown again. Give it to the person: they must change it at their first sign-in.
staff.resetText: A new temporary password will be created and the old one will stop working. The person will be signed out of their devices.
staff.disableText: The person will no longer be able to sign in. Their past records are kept. You can enable the account again.
staff.teachingNeedsRole: Give the Teacher role first to assign classes.
staff.subject: Subject
staff.intro: Staff accounts, their roles and the classes each teacher takes.

setup.title: Year setup
setup.remaining_one: {{count}} step left before teachers can take attendance.
setup.remaining_other: {{count}} steps left before teachers can take attendance.
setup.allReady: Everything is in place: teachers can take attendance.
setup.timetableDetail_one: {{count}} lesson placed out of {{capacity}} weekly slots
setup.timetableDetail_other: {{count}} lessons placed out of {{capacity}} weekly slots
setup.timetableNone: Create the classes and periods first.
setup.noYear: Create the school year in the calendar.

import.title: Import students
import.intro: One academic year's students and their guardians' phone numbers, from a CSV or Excel file.
import.accepted: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), 5 MB and 5,000 students at most.
import.fileType: Choose a CSV (.csv) or Excel (.xlsx) file.
import.fileTooBig: The file is over 5 MB. Remove unused columns or split it.
import.nothingYet: Nothing is imported at this step: you will see any errors first.
import.templateHint: A CSV file with the right headers and two made-up students to replace.
import.ruleHeaders: Row 1 holds the headers. Columns the template does not know are ignored.
import.ruleClass: The class must exist in the chosen academic year.
import.ruleBirth: Only the birth year is kept.
import.ruleGuardian: A guardian is recognised by their phone number: brothers and sisters share one guardian.
import.errorsIntro_one: Nothing has been imported. Correct the row listed below in your file, then upload it again.
import.errorsIntro_other: Nothing has been imported. Correct the {{count}} rows listed below in your file, then upload it again.
import.readyText: Importing creates the students, their guardians and the links between them, all at once. A guardian the school already knows is linked without being changed.
import.confirmText_one: {{count}} student will be added to the {{year}} academic year, with their guardians.
import.confirmText_other: {{count}} students will be added to the {{year}} academic year, with their guardians.
import.doneText: The students are now in their classes, with their guardians.
import.committedBefore: This file has already been imported.
import.expired: This preview has expired: a preview not imported is deleted after 7 days. Upload the file again.

guardians.title: Guardians and invitations
guardians.intro: A class's guardians and their invitation code. The code goes by SMS; the parent uses it to activate the app.
guardians.pickClass: Choose a class to see its guardians.
guardians.empty: No guardians in this class. Import the students with their guardians first.
guardians.resendText: {{name}} already has a valid code. The new code replaces it: the old one will stop working.
guardians.classText_one: A code goes by SMS to the guardian who has no account yet. If they already had a code, the new one replaces it.
guardians.classText_other: A code goes by SMS to each of the {{count}} guardians who have no account yet. Those who already had a code get a new one, which replaces the old one.
guardians.classSent_one: 1 code sent by SMS. Guardians already signed up, no code: {{skipped}}.
guardians.classSent_other: {{count}} codes sent by SMS. Guardians already signed up, no code: {{skipped}}.

dm.dashboardIntro: Absences and lateness in the classes you follow. Cancelled records are not counted.
dm.rangeInvalid: The end date must be on or after the start date.
dm.noActivity: No attendance taken and no lateness recorded in this period.
dm.alertsIntro: SchoolLink only raises the alert. You decide what happens next.

evidence.FULL_DAY_ABSENCE_other: Absent from every lesson {{count}} days running: {{dates}}
evidence.UNJUSTIFIED_ABSENCES_one: 1 lesson missed without justification from {{from}} to {{to}}
evidence.UNJUSTIFIED_ABSENCES_other: {{count}} lessons missed without justification from {{from}} to {{to}}

decisionIntro.SUMMON: The parents are told at once, by the app or by SMS.
decisionIntro.DISMISS: The alert is closed. Say why.
decisionIntro.REFER: A file is opened for the counsellor.

dm.meetingDefault: Next school day, when classes start
dm.summonReasonHelp: Kept in your records. Parents get the day and time, not the reason.
dm.studentsIntro: Find a student of your classes to see their absences and lateness.
dm.noStudentFound: No student of your classes matches.
dm.noRecords: No absence and no lateness in this period.
dm.selectHint: Tick the unjustified records to justify them together.
dm.justifyIntro: One reason for all of them. Parents who were told see the justification.
dm.illnessNoNote: “Illness” is enough: no health details are kept.
dm.cancelIntro: {{what}}. Only for a mistake. The record stays in the school's files but no longer counts. Parents who were told get a correction.
dm.settingsIntro: When SchoolLink raises an alert, when school starts, and when parents get the SMS digest. These settings apply to the whole school.
dm.rulesIntro: A rule switched off raises no alert. Alerts already raised stay.

ruleHelp.FULL_DAY_ABSENCE_one: An alert when a student misses every lesson of a day.
ruleHelp.FULL_DAY_ABSENCE_other: An alert when a student misses every lesson {{count}} days running.
ruleHelp.CONSECUTIVE_LATENESS_one: An alert when a student arrives late.
ruleHelp.CONSECUTIVE_LATENESS_other: An alert when a student arrives late {{count}} school days running.
ruleHelp.UNJUSTIFIED_ABSENCES_one: An alert at the first unjustified missed lesson of the term.
ruleHelp.UNJUSTIFIED_ABSENCES_other: An alert at {{count}} unjustified missed lessons in the term.

dm.timesIntro: Arriving after the start time counts as late at the gate.
dm.startTimeHelp: Also the default time of a summons.
dm.digestHelp: Parents without the app get one SMS with the day's absences and lateness, at these times.

dashboard.title: School dashboard
dashboard.intro: Attendance, lateness, alerts and parent notifications for the whole school. Cancelled records are not counted.
dashboard.showData: Show the figures behind the charts
dashboard.notificationsIntro: Every notification sent so far. Parents with the app get a notification; the others get an SMS.
dashboard.capReached: Cap reached: until the end of the month, only summons go out by SMS. Parents with the app still get notifications.

letterhead.title: Document letterhead
letterhead.intro: The official header printed at the top of the reports the Discipline Master shares. It applies to the whole school.

layoutHelp.BILINGUAL: French on the left, logo in the centre, English on the right
layoutHelp.FRENCH: The logo, then the French text centred
layoutHelp.ENGLISH: The logo, then the English text centred

letterhead.notPrinted: This column is kept but not printed with the chosen layout.
letterhead.emptyLine: Type the line's text, or delete the line.
letterhead.logoHelp: PNG or JPEG, at most 1 MB. The logo is saved as soon as it is chosen.
letterhead.logoType: The logo must be a PNG or JPEG image.
letterhead.logoTooLarge: The logo must not be larger than 1 MB.
